from collections import Counter, defaultdict

# Build map playlist_id -> list of song_ids
playlist_songs = {p['playlist_id']: p.get('song_ids', []) for p in all_playlists}
print('playlists', len(playlist_songs))
print('songs total', sum(len(v) for v in playlist_songs.values()))

# Fetch genre for each song
song_genre = {}
for pid, song_ids in playlist_songs.items():
    for sid in song_ids:
        if sid in song_genre:
            continue
        s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
        # Determine genre field
        genre = s.get('genre')
        if not genre:
            # fallback to first artist genre if present
            artists = s.get('artists') or []
            genre = artists[0].get('genre') if artists and isinstance(artists[0], dict) else None
        song_genre[sid] = genre

print('unique songs', len(song_genre))
# Print a few samples
items = list(song_genre.items())
print('sample song genres', items[:10])

# Update playlist titles
playlist_updates = []
for p in all_playlists:
    pid = p['playlist_id']
    orig_title = p['title']
    most = playlist_most_common[pid]['most_common_genre']
    new_title = f"{orig_title} | {most}"
    playlist_updates.append((pid, orig_title, most, new_title))

results = []
for pid, orig_title, most, new_title in playlist_updates:
    res = apis.spotify.update_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=spotify_token, title=new_title)
    results.append((pid, res, new_title))
    print('updated', pid, '->', new_title, 'api_message', res)

print('total_updates', len(results))

# Verification: fetch playlist titles once
verified = []
for p in all_playlists:
    pid = p['playlist_id']
    expected = f"{p['title']} | {playlist_most_common[pid]['most_common_genre']}"
    sp = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=spotify_token)
    actual = sp.get('title')
    verified.append((pid, expected, actual))
    print('verify', pid, 'expected', expected, 'actual', actual)

all_ok = all(exp==act for _,exp,act in verified)
print('all_ok', all_ok)
